activation: tanh after every layer except the last
weight_layout: row-major float32, shape [out_features, in_features] per layer, y = W @ x
output_postprocess: direction (dirx_o,diry_o,dirz_o) must be re-normalized to unit length after the last layer -- it is NOT already unit from the raw network output
required_preprocessing_before_calling_th: rotate entry (position,direction) about the optical axis so entry position lands on x=0 (see canonicalize.py:canonicalize_input)
if the rotated dirx_i is still negative, mirror-fold it (flip sign) before calling the network
after calling the network, undo the mirror fold on dirx_o/x_o, then undo the rotation on (x_o,z_o) and (dirx_o,dirz_o)
